capabilities: Browse daily notes in an infinite-scroll timeline view
Jump to a specific date from a calendar UI
Extract landmarks such as tasks, lists, links, images, callouts and headings from daily notes
Filter timeline entries by search term with highlighted matches
extras: README recommends installing via BRAT; full instructions appear to live outside the README.
intentEvidence: This plugin inherits settings from the core plugin Daily Notes
problem: Obsidian's Daily notes core plugin opens one note at a time, with no way to browse across many daily notes chronologically.

relations.evidence: This plugin inherits settings from the core plugin Daily Notes

summary: Timeline view that renders daily notes in a scrollable timeline with landmark filtering and search.
